items.title: Homelab Youtube Podcasts to AudioBookShelf Pipeline
items.content_html:
I wrote about using Homelab Pinchflat for at-home mashup creation and a song flow for church. But I use it for more than, that and here’s another prime use case

There are podcasts on YouTube I want to follow - The Standup with Prime, or Shawn Ryan’s show. Basically I use pinchflat to download the audio and serve up those files in ABS (audiobookshelf)
